description: Look up a Texas Attorney General opinion by its number (e.g. "KP-0537", "GA-0153") -- returns the AG, date, requestor, RQ- request number, topic categories, one-sentence summary, full opinion text, statute citations found in it (best-effort), and whether it has a recorded overruled/modified/affirmed/withdrawn status. Sourced live from texasattorneygeneral.gov/opinions.

opinion_number.description: Opinion number, e.g. "KP-0537", "GA-0153", "DM-212". Case- and spacing-insensitive.

name: tx_ag_opinion_lookup
